home.subtitle.on: Just speak. Whisper stays on this Mac, and correction uses your OpenAI key.
home.subtitle.custom: Just speak. Whisper stays on this Mac, and correction uses the address in Settings.
home.subtitle.off: Just speak. Flow writes privately, with Whisper and Qwen on this Mac.
home.emptyBody: Click into a text field, hold %@, and start speaking.
home.tipRewrite: Select text and say what should change
menu.correctionNeedsKey: API key missing — add it in Settings
onboarding.welcome.on:
Speak naturally. Flow writes clean text into every app.
Whisper listens on this Mac, OpenAI phrases it.
onboarding.welcome.custom:
Speak naturally. Flow writes clean text into every app.
Whisper listens on this Mac, and correction uses your API.
onboarding.welcome.off:
Speak naturally. Flow writes clean text into every app —
entirely on this Mac with Whisper and Qwen.
onboarding.fast.title: Three times faster than typing
onboarding.fast.body: Hold a key, speak, let go.
onboarding.polish.title: Phrases it for you
onboarding.polish.body: Filler words out, punctuation in, the right style.
onboarding.private.on.title: The recording stays here
onboarding.private.on.body: Only the recognized text goes to OpenAI for correction, with your key.
onboarding.private.custom.title: The recording stays here
onboarding.private.custom.body: Only the recognized text goes to the address you set for correction.
onboarding.private.off.title: Private
onboarding.private.off.body: Audio and text never leave your Mac.
onboarding.mic.title: Allow the microphone
onboarding.mic.body: Flow listens only while you hold the key. The recording is processed on this Mac.
onboarding.ax.title: Allow Accessibility
onboarding.ax.body: That is how Flow sees the dictation key in every app and inserts the text at the cursor.
onboarding.ax.note: Turn Flow on in the list. If Flow is already there, switch it off and on again.
onboarding.try.title: Try it
onboarding.try.sample: “Um, please remind me tomorrow at ten about the offer for Miller.”
history.title: History
history.subtitle: Click an entry to see the raw text.
history.emptyBody: Every dictation lands here, with the spoken raw text and the finished result.
dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: Terms Flow should prefer, and what it should write when recognition gets them wrong.
dictionary.termPlaceholder: How it should read, e.g. Flow
dictionary.heardPlaceholder: What was recognized? e.g. flow app
dictionary.spellingOnly.title: Correct form
dictionary.spellingOnly.body: This word is weighted. If the left field is filled, Flow always replaces that with this.
dictionary.withHeard.title: What comes in
dictionary.withHeard.body: Optional. The form Whisper or correction gets wrong.
dictionary.learn.title: Learn from edits
dictionary.learn.detail: When you briefly correct inserted text, Flow adds that to the dictionary.
dictionary.emptyBody: Add names of customers, colleagues, or products.
style.title: Style
style.subtitle: Flow picks the style from the frontmost app. It uses the default when none is recognized.
style.custom.title: Your own instruction
style.custom.body: Applies to every dictation, for example: formal voice, short sentences, no emoji.
style.custom.placeholder: Write formally and keep sentences short.
style.languageHint: A fixed language makes Whisper more accurate.
style.command.title: Command mode
style.command.body: Select text and say, for example, “make this friendlier” or “translate this into English”.
style.perApp.title: Per app
style.perApp.body: The list comes from the Applications folder and grows with the apps you open. You can change the style here.
style.auto.blurb: Detects whether you are dictating an email, a list, or a short message.
style.auto.before: um can you send me the numbers tomorrow
style.auto.after: Can you send me the numbers tomorrow?
style.literal.blurb: Only filler words and punctuation. Your wording stays.
style.literal.before: so yeah that works for me I guess
style.email.blurb: Greeting, paragraphs, and sign-off — ready to send.
style.email.before: hi ms berg thanks for your reply best regards dieter
style.email.after:
Hi Ms Berg,

Thank you for your reply.

Best regards
Dieter
style.chat.blurb: Short and casual for Slack, WhatsApp, and Teams.
style.chat.before: be there in five minutes um bringing coffee
style.chat.after: Be there in 5 minutes, bringing coffee!
style.notes.blurb: Clear points and paragraphs for thoughts and minutes.
style.notes.before: points for the meeting budget timeline and new campaign
style.notes.after:
Points for the meeting:
- Budget
- Timeline
- New campaign
style.code.blurb: Identifiers, spelling, and symbols stay intact.
style.code.before: function get user by id with parameter id
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Key, recording, permissions, speech recognition, and correction.
settings.hotkey.title: Dictation key
settings.hotkey.detail: Fn is the default. Hold to speak, double-tap to speak freely.
settings.native.title: Native language
settings.recognition.title: Recognition
settings.recognition.detail: Whisper is more accurate when the language is fixed.
settings.correction.title: Automatic correction
settings.sounds.title: Sounds
settings.sounds.detail: A short sound at the start and the end.
settings.mute.title: Other audio output
settings.mute.detail: While you speak. Afterwards the sound is as it was. Quieter lowers the volume, mute silences it.
settings.rewrite.title: Rewrite selected text
settings.rewrite.detail: What you say becomes the instruction for the selection.
settings.login.title: Launch at login
settings.login.detail: Flow is then ready in the menu bar.
settings.mic.detail: So Flow can hear your voice.
settings.ax.detail: For the global key and for inserting text into other apps.
settings.ax.banner: For the global key and for inserting text. If Flow is already on, switch it off and on again.
settings.ax.repair: The switch is on but Flow still says no? Remove the Flow entry, or switch it off and on, then restart Flow.
main.ax.repair: After an update the switch often still looks on, but it applies to the old version. Remove Flow from the list, or switch it off and on, then restart Flow.
settings.whisper.local: Stored locally on this Mac, in the Flow folder.
settings.asr.title: Speech recognition
settings.asr.detail: Model file in the Flow folder. The recording does not go to the cloud.
settings.api.title: API address
settings.api.detail: OpenAI is the default. For a local or other model, enter the base address, for example http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.
settings.key.title: API key
settings.key.detail: Only for correction. ⌘V or Paste. After that it lives in the Keychain.
settings.key.detailCustom: Optional. Some local models need no key. A key lives in the Keychain, not in the config file.
settings.model.customHint: Leave this empty and Flow uses the first model at that address. Otherwise type the name.
settings.model.title: Correction model
settings.storage.title: Storage
settings.storage.detail: Settings, history, and the log stay on this Mac.
settings.footer.on: Flow %@ · The recording stays on this Mac. For correction, the text goes to OpenAI.
settings.footer.custom: Flow %@ · The recording stays on this Mac. For correction, the recognized text goes to the address you set.
settings.footer.off: Flow %@ · Audio and text never leave your Mac.
settings.model.noKey: The recommendation is always the newest fast tier for your key.
settings.model.looking: Looking up the recommendation with your key.
settings.model.auto: Recommended: %@. You can pin another model in the menu.
settings.model.typeName: Type a model name, or pick one once the address lists it.
settings.correction.off: Off. Whisper writes the text as it hears it.
settings.correction.noKey: On, but without an API key it stays with Whisper. Add the key below.
settings.correction.on: OpenAI rephrases the text. The recording stays on this Mac.
settings.correction.custom: The address you set rephrases the text. The recording stays on this Mac.
main.needsPermissionsBody: Without them Flow cannot listen or insert text.
ax.repair.title: Repair Accessibility
ax.repair.body: After an update, the old switch often no longer applies to the new Flow version.
ax.step1: Open Accessibility and find Flow in the list.
ax.step2: Switch it off, wait a moment, switch it on — or remove Flow and add it again.
ax.step3: Back in Flow: the status below changes to “Allowed”.
overlay.drag: Drag to move · hold %@ to dictate
engine.settingUp: Setting up the engine… (once, a few minutes)
engine.setupFailed: Setup failed — see the log in Settings
engine.readyNeedsKey: Ready · correction still needs the API key
engine.missingPython: The local engine is not installed.
